figures.finding: A resident pays national income tax on each dollar of income at 10.5% to $15,600, 17.5% to $53,500, 30% to $78,100, 33% to $180,000 and 39% above, with no tax-free amount and no regional layer.
figures.applies: Residents, tax years from 1 April 2025 (so the 2026-27 year, 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027)

figures.finding: The tax year runs from 1 April to 31 March; an individual's IR3 return is due by 7 July (later with a tax agent or an extension), and a bill is generally due on 7 February of the year after.

value.paymentDue: 02-07 of the following year (bill example: 2024-25 year due 7 February 2026)

figures.finding: Every earner pays the ACC earners' levy of 1.75% (GST included) on earnings up to $156,641 for 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 (1.83% up to $160,244 from 1 April 2027).
figures.applies: Employees (deducted through PAYE) and the self-employed (invoiced by ACC)

figures.finding: KiwiSaver: an employee member contributes 3.5% of pay by default (or 4, 6, 8 or 10%), and the employer must contribute at least 3.5% of gross salary or wages.
figures.applies: Employees who are KiwiSaver members (employer contribution for members aged 16 to under 65)

sources.said: Employees You can choose to contribute 3.5%, 4%, 6%, 8% or 10% of your pay. The default rate is 3.5% if you do not choose a higher rate.
The lowest rate for your contribution is 3.5% of your employee’s gross salary or wages unless your employee is on a temporary rate reduction.

figures.finding: A resident contractor paid as an entertainer, or for on-set and off-set film, video or television production work, has 20% withheld as a schedular payment; freelance contributions for radio, television or stage bear 25%; 45% applies with no notification; a tailored rate may be set.
